program.name: freeway-explicit-entry-wait-v1
program.guidance: Follow this traffic-entry rule for the left chicken. Boxes are [x,y,width,height]; UP decreases y by about one pixel per raw frame. A choice lasts 16 raw frames. First consider only cars whose lane is just above the chicken: car_y+10 <= player_y and player_y-16 < car_y+10. If no such lane exists, choose UP. For each eligible car, estimate horizontal velocity from the latest history: dx=(current_x-previous_x+80) modulo 160 minus 80; velocity=dx/elapsed_raw_frames. Predict the car position during the next 16 frames, wrapping at screen boundaries. The chicken would enter that lane after player_y-(car_y+10) frames. If the car overlaps chicken x=44..50, with a two-pixel safety margin, at any time from that entry until min(16,player_y+8-car_y), choose NOOP and wait. Otherwise choose UP. Do not stop for a car in a lane the chicken cannot yet enter, or for a car already passed vertically. While already inside a lane, continue UP. DOWN is unnecessary under this rule. Waiting now is useful only when predicted overlap blocks the next upward move. After each decision reassess from new history.

action_criteria.NOOP: The next upward move enters a lane during predicted horizontal overlap: wait.
action_criteria.UP: No predicted overlap in a lane entered by the next 16-frame upward move: advance.
action_criteria.DOWN: Retreat downward; not prescribed by the stated entry-wait rule.
